step1_analysis.description: A capacitive feedback amplifier used as a multiplying DAC (MDAC) stage in a pipeline ADC. It amplifies the residue signal for the next stage. The netlist represents the amplification phase where C1 acts as the feedback capacitor.

paper_reference.title: Oversampled Pipeline A/D Converters With Mismatch Shaping

closed_loop_gain.description: Closed-loop AC voltage gain of the MDAC stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Set by capacitor ratio C_in/C_fb = 2 (6.02 dB)
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the feedback network ratio for a 1-bit pipeline stage.
Depends on op-amp GBW and feedback factor. Adjusted macro model to match the paper's 61 MHz.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the closed-loop system

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for stable settling in switched-capacitor circuits.

step3_testbench.description: Measures closed-loop gain, -3dB bandwidth, and transient swing of the MDAC stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* MDAC Stage Testbench
.param C_in=2p C_fb=1p C_load=1p

* DUT (Note: A1 changed to X1 for standard SPICE compatibility, C values parameterized)
X1 VI_N N1 GND amplifier
C1 VI_N N1 {C_fb}
C2 N1 VREF {C_load}

* External components for testing (Input cap and DC bias path)
Cin VIN VI_N {C_in}
Rbias VI_N GND 1G

* Sources
VVREF VREF 0 0.9
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 10Meg)
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Amplifier macro model (Tuned for ~61MHz closed-loop BW)
.subckt amplifier in out gnd
G1 gnd out_int gnd in 1m
R1 out_int gnd 100k
C1 out_int gnd 0.87p
E1 out gnd out_int gnd 1
.ends

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 100k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
let gain_db_3db = midband_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 200n
meas tran v_out_max max v(N1)
meas tran v_out_min min v(N1)
let v_pp = v_out_max - v_out_min

print midband_gain
print bw_3db
print v_pp
quit
.endc
